notes.title: Version 2.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello! Version 2.0 of Spare Parts: Episode 2 is now available to download. It features:



Improved sprites

A lot of small/medium edits

Small changes to match the Episode 1 update

New UI


...And some other small things! It's not nearly as extensive an update as Episode 1's, but I put a lot of work in to improve the writing in small ways, as well as updating the sprites and UI.


Let me also take this opportunity to say that Episode 3 is, indeed, still in development. An early access version is available elsewhere, if you're interested in such a thing. You can follow me on Bluesky if you'd like more updates about that.


If you run into any issues, please feel free to contact me at sofycrystals@gmail.com. Thank you!
